name: As Samawah

queries.query: As Samawah Iraq official cadastral parcel map GIS API municipality land registry
queries.result: Found official Iraqi Ministry of Justice land-registration service material and the Iraq Geographic Portal. The official material establishes national land-registration custody and general geospatial services, but no public anonymous As Samawah parcel feature service or downloadable parcel geometry was exposed.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Ministry of Justice, Iraq / Real Estate Registration Department
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official announcement describes electronic deed, property-map and real-estate-registration services; the listed initial directorates are in Baghdad, not As Samawah.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Iraq Unified Electronic Portal / Ministry of Justice
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official service page describes requesting a deed and property map from the competent registration directorate; it is an owner/document workflow and states online availability currently in Baghdad.

Official portal page lists a Ministry of Construction/Housing/Municipalities service for state-land ownership locations by governorate and real-estate-registration circles; it is not a public parcel boundary layer.
Search lead claiming property maps and records; not treated as first-party government evidence and no request was made.

requests.assessment: Official Ministry of Justice HTML reached anonymously; inspected current page and identified registration-department announcement and service links; no parcel geometry endpoint.
Official Ur Portal page reached anonymously; describes deed/property-map request procedure, authentication/document requirements, and Baghdad-only current availability.
Official IGP services page reached anonymously; current HTML lists state-land ownership service and links to View.aspx?i=8026a1f8-8a7a-474d-8cdb-fbefea9a7ca9.
Anonymous request returned the portal homepage/news content rather than a map or documented parcel service; no further endpoint was guessed or queried.
Official service application shell reached but requires JavaScript/authenticated workflow; no anonymous parcel geometry or safe ID response.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Iraqi national real-estate registration and official geographic-portal service pages.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous parcel response with stable native ID and polygon geometry verified.

IGP service internals, local Dhi Qar/As Samawah endpoints, and non-indexed services remain unknown. A zero exact-point hit was not used as evidence.
